jobs.title: Secure Remote Access The Speed of VPN and the Security of ZTNA Combined
jobs.description: Skip to main content Zero Latency. Zero Open Ports. Zero Trust. Connect remote employees and third parties to your network with zero trust principles and maximum performance. Request a Demo Watch the Video Revolutionizing Remote Access Combine Speed with Security Don’t trade protection for performance. Zero combines the speed of VPN with the security of ZTNA to securely connect remote employees and vendors. Gain Visibility, Control Access Unlike ZTNA, the IP address of connected users is never obfuscated – allowing for maximum visibility and granular access control through custom policies. Optimized User Experience Designed to be installed, deployed and managed seamlessly, Zero’s solution leverages a light-weight client, based on WireGuard ®, that is auto-updateable and requires no maintenance. How It Works A ZTNA and VPN Hybrid: All the benefits, none of the downsides VPN ports are closed and invisible The corporate VPN has no open ports on the internet and is impervious to port scanning. Users must be verified by MFA Connection won’t be granted without authentication. User is validated, access is granted VPN opens a port that can only be used with the authenticated user’s IP address for a specified amount of time. The port remains invisible to hackers. User access is limited Policies allow user access to all or pre-approved apps and services. ZERO TO THE RESCUE Secure in just a few clicks Without Zero Deploy Zero Visible to hackers VPN ports are open and visible to the internet and attackers. Limited controls and visibility VPN doesn’t provide granularity or access control; ZTNA doesn’t provide unique IP addresses. Compliance issues Difficulty demonstrating compliance – no granular access controls, data logging, and user activity tracking. From governing overprivileged AI agents to stopping lateral movement to proving compliance in real time – Zero delivers control across a spectrum of AI security challenges. Download datasheet SaaS AI Control Zero governs which cloud AI services users and devices can access on your network. If you're paying for Copilot, nothing on your network should be reaching ChatGPT. Zero enforces that automatically. AI Agent Control Every AI agent is a process – and like any process, it has an identity. Zero applies the same identity-based controls governing every user and device to every agent in your environment, enforcing strict least-privilege boundaries on every interaction. LLM Protection Your model infrastructure is code – and like any code, it can be altered, abused or compromised. Zero segments it at the network layer so only authorized systems can reach it. You can't tamper what you can't reach. AI Lateral Movement Control Zero removes the connectivity that enables lateral movement to ensure unauthorized users, systems, or AI agents can’t reach critical resources. AI-Powered Compliance & Risk Engine Query live network activity in natural language, get dynamic risk scores mapped to NIS2 and CIS, and identify the most critical gaps in real time – not at audit time. ZERO TO THE RESCUE Secure AI in just a few clicks.
